verdict.rationale: `bun install` is documented as a one-command bootstrap that reads package.json/workspaces, resolves and installs all declared dependencies (including devDependencies control, overrides/resolutions, trustedDependencies), uses a lockfile (bun.lock) for reproducibility via --frozen-lockfile, and even auto-migrates existing npm/yarn/pnpm lockfiles on first run in a fresh clone. Community evidence corroborates real-world use as a drop-in package manager, though some report install-related bugs/crashes in edge cases (old lockfiles, WSL/Windows switching). Missing for 10: independent benchmark/reproducibility audits beyond vendor docs, and resolution of the reported install-crash edge cases.
